# BotCommand

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.BotCommand`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(
    command: str,

): ...
```

## Documentation

A bot command with the standard slash "/" prefix.

### Parameters

- **`command`** (`str`)
  Text of the command; 1-32 characters.
  Can contain only lowercase English letters, digits and underscores.

- **`description`** (`str`)
  Description of the command; 1-256 characters.

- **`is_ephemeral`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the command is sent as an ephemeral message: only the bot will see it.

_Source: `pyrogram/types/bots_and_keyboards/bot_command.py`._
